findings.title: An email, link or code that will scramble
findings.message: "#DXB-98421" sits in right-to-left text without isolation, so part of it can move.
findings.fix: Wrap it in <bdi>, or give its element dir="ltr".

findings.title: Position, float or border that does not mirror
findings.message: left: -30px stays on the same side in Arabic.
findings.fix: Use inset-inline-start, float: inline-start, border-inline-start and border-start-start-radius.
